ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the Cartesian coordinate system $xOy$, point $A$ is on the positive half of the $y$-axis, and point $B$ is on the positive half of the $x$-axis, with $OA = OB = 10$. What is the equation of line $AB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point $A$ is on the positive half of the y-axis, and point $B$ is on the positive half of the x-axis, with $OA=OB=10$, \\
thus $A\left(0, 10\right)$, $B\left(10, 0\right)$. \\
Let the equation of line $AB$ be $y=kx+b$, \\
hence $\begin{cases}10k+b=0\\ b=10\end{cases}$, solving gives: \\
$\begin{cases}k=-1\\ b=10\end{cases}$, \\
thus the equation of line $AB$ is $\boxed{y=-x+10}$.
